Factor Mine sequential rebuild

Session percents come from data/factor_mine/daily_returns.csv. Book equity is the last file under data/factor_mine/state/<recipe>/. A day before created_on is designed_after and is not in the real total. timing_clean is the pit_rebuilt flag. The chain multiplies the published session percents. The calendar is not rebuilt. A recipe with zero fills is untestable: its return cells stay blank.
